name: horenova-mobile
description: HORENOVA iOS and Android store submission candidate (unsigned)

scripts.build:web: node scripts/prepare-web.mjs && node scripts/generate-icon.mjs && node scripts/bundle-native.mjs
scripts.android:init: npm run build:web && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios:init: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
